Group Name: Profile_Cdr_group

Routing Document Type: telecom KPI group routing

Primary Purpose:

This is the master CRM account and demographic profile table. It holds the core identity of the subscriber: Account IDs, Subscriber IDs, MSISDN Index, and base line type (Prepaid/Postpaid). It tracks the origins and age of the account: Activation Date, subscriber tenure (Age on Network), Cust Dealer, Activation Source/Channel, and onboarding method. It also stores human demographics, external credit ratings, device details, plan migrations, and static service flags (Mobile App User, TV service). Use this table for ANY query asking for Account/Subscriber IDs, activation dates/channels, tenure, dealers, base line types, or demographic profiles.

Data Type / Table Style: master profile and account dimension

Data Granularity: one record per subscriber account

Refresh Pattern: daily

Typical Time Windows: current state, D-1

- numeric Subscriber ID, MSISDN, or Customer Account Number
- Cust Dealer or Activation channel who activated the SIM
- subscriber tenure, age on network, or activation date
- current subscribed service category like Mobile Postpaid
- is this customer a Mobile App User or have TV service
- customer is from India
- Indian customers
- customers whose nationality is India
- female subscribers
- customers activated through dealer channel
- customers using iPhone
- customers on prepaid plan

- Profile_Cdr_Nationality: The registered nationality of the subscriber.
- Profile_Cdr_Gender: The registered gender of the subscriber.
- Profile_Cdr_Activation_Channel: The specific sales channel (e.g., Retail, Franchise) where the subscriber initially activated.

Group Name: Common_Seg_Fct

Primary Purpose:

This is the consolidated usage and revenue fact table used for segmentation, ARPU tracking, and overall subscriber spending. It provides the most granular breakdown of usage and aggregated revenue: data usage and revenue, voice usage split by on-net and off-net, IDD, SMS usage, and roaming. Critically, this table tracks overall 'Prepaid Subscription Revenue', 'Prepay Spending', and prepaid revenue breakdown by service type. Use this table when the query needs detailed usage breakdowns (like on-net vs off-net from bundles), monthly/rolling trend comparisons, ARPU calculations, GCC roaming data, or total prepaid subscription revenue/spending.

It stores recharge amount, denomination, channel or type of recharge (e-wallet, retail, bank), recharge date and hour, recharge frequency metrics, rolling recharge revenue aggregates over 1 day, 15 days, 90 days, and 180 days, and average recharge metrics. Group Name: LIFECYCLE_CDR

Routing Document Type: telecom KPI group routing

Primary Purpose:

This table tracks all campaign and marketing interactions at the subscriber level. It stores which bonus campaigns and promotional campaigns were sent to each subscriber, when they were sent, how many times, and whether they were delivered successfully or failed. It also tracks whether subscribers responded to campaigns or ignored them (non-responders). It contains campaign response codes, action keys for customer segments, and rolling time window aggregates over 2 days, 7 days, 30 days, 180 days, and 365 days. Use this table when the query involves campaign performance, campaign delivery, campaign response, marketing lifecycle, or any promotional activity tracking.

Data Type / Table Style: summarized

Data Granularity: one record per subscriber with rolling aggregates

Group Name: Instant_cdr_group

Routing Document Type: telecom KPI group routing

Primary Purpose:

This table captures near real-time transactional events AND dynamic billing/lifecycle statuses. It stores voice/SMS/data session events (including the individual event-level revenue, charge, or cost for those specific OG/IDD calls and texts). It is the EXCLUSIVE table for digital wallet transactions, mobile money, fintech, and 'Money Trans Amount'. Crucially, it tracks all loan and credit activity (airtime advances, outstanding debt) and dynamic lifecycle status changes (Active/Grace). Use this table for real-time/instant events, wallet/mobile money transactions, event-level call/SMS charges, OR anytime a query asks for loan balances, debt, or current lifecycle state.

Group Name: Subscriptions

Routing Document Type: telecom KPI group routing

Primary Purpose:

This table is strictly a ledger for ADD-ON product subscription events (activations and renewals). It tracks when a subscriber purchases extra products: data bundles, VAS (value-added services), roaming packs, and digital services. Each record represents a single add-on purchase event. Use this table ONLY when the query is about buying or renewing specific add-on products, bundles, or VAS.

Data Type / Table Style: summarized with event-level detail

Data Granularity: one record per subscriber per add-on subscription event
